versions.changelog:
Initial release — comprehensive reference and expert tips for Starship Prompt.

- Covers full installation and setup for Linux (Fedora) and Fish shell.
- Complete CLI command and flag reference included.
- Detailed TOML configuration: schema, format strings, style strings, palettes, and advanced features.
- Exhaustive listing and summary for all ~70 modules, with key config highlights.
- Special sections for Fish shell integration, transient prompt, custom modules, and Claude Code statusline support.
- Designed as a single-stop, in-depth resource for Starship users.
